facts.fact: The OTR statistics page of 20 February 2026 reports VAT returns filed electronically (teledeclaration) at 100% for the DGE and DME directorates and 26% for DCIG/DOFAN/DOFR in 2025.
The OTR statistics page of 20 February 2026 reports VAT paid electronically (telepaiement) at 100% for the DGE and DME directorates and 24% for DCIG/DOFAN/DOFR in 2025.
The OTR statistics page of 20 February 2026 puts the share of VAT returns filed online at 100% in 2025 for the DGE and DME directorates, and 26% for the DCIG/DOFAN/DOFR directorates.
